links.outcome: Acceptability of ChatGPT drafted replies to easy versus difficult patient messages
links.effect: 56% of responses to easy questions acceptable to send vs 34% for difficult questions (P = .03); easy-question responses were more accurate, complete, helpful, and intelligible.
links.quote: ChatGPT performed better on easy questions with 56% of responses to easy questions being acceptable to send as compared to 34% of difficult questions (P = .03).

screen.reason: Evaluated the quality and safety of ChatGPT-generated responses to real-world patient inbox messages retrospectively assessed by urologists, without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
